AudienceTap is your go-to SMS marketing platform, designed to cut through the noise and drive sales with text-based automation. Unlike traditional email or social media channels, AudienceTap offers a direct and reliable way to reach your customers, giving you significantly higher open and conversation rates. With Text-to-Buy, customers can complete orders entirely via text — no external links or lengthy checkouts needed. Plus, AudienceTap offers interactive surveys, RCS messaging, and automated drip campaigns, making it easy to deliver personalized experiences that connect with your audience. Whether you’re pushing a new product or rolling out special offers, every text becomes a chance to drive sales. Authvia
Authvia is a leading innovator in conversational commerce, offering the industry's only patented messaging and payment platform that enables businesses to get paid faster, more securely, and with less friction, all through the channels customers use every day. With TXT2PAY®, our flagship solution, we turn everyday messaging platforms like SMS, email, and popular chat apps into powerful, PCI-compliant payment engines. Built for merchants, ISVs, banks, and payment providers, Authvia makes it easier than ever to embed fast, secure payments into any workflow or system. Whether you're sending invoices, collecting past-due balances, enabling curbside checkout, or streamlining phone-based transactions, Authvia is the "easy button" for payments and messaging, no apps, no downloads, no hassle. Merchants benefit from immediate value: * Faster Time to Cash: One-click, in-message payments dramatically reduce DSO and improve cash flow. * Higher Conversion Rates: Reduce cart abandonment with frictionless checkout directly from messaging apps. * Improved Customer Experience: Secure, app-free payments make the process simple and seamless for consumers. * Reduced Operational Costs: Eliminate the need for manual invoicing, paper billing, and call-based collections. * Better Collections: Use automated reminders and partial payment options to recover more revenue with less effort. * Enhanced Security & Compliance: Authvia is PCI Level 1 compliant. Payment data never touches merchant systems, minimizing risk. Our platform supports multiple use cases, including: * Billing & Invoicing * Collections & Reminders * Pickup, Delivery & On-the-Go Payments * Recurring & Scheduled Payments * ID Verification & Card Updates * Hosted Checkouts & Batch Billing * Payouts and Disbursements With over 250 payment gateway integrations and a developer-friendly API, Authvia makes it simple to go live, without requiring a merchant to switch processors. Onboarding is fast, seamless, and designed to reduce friction for both technical and non-technical teams. Whether you're a merchant looking to get paid faster or a technology partner seeking to embed modern payment experiences into your platform, Authvia offers a future-ready solution that scales with your business. Discover how Authvia is transforming how money moves, one message at a time.

Before Canva, creating a professional looking design was a complex process - you had to purchase expensive software; learn how to use it; purchase stock photography and fonts for the software; decide on a layout; slice images; receive photos and content via email; design something; upload and email the pdf only to find revisions needed to be made … and then finally be able to prepare your design for web or print. Since launching in August 2013, Canva has been changing the way in which we communicate. Today our design tool has attracted over 15 million happy users across 190 countries, who have collectively created more than 1 billion designs. With an integrated marketplace that has both free and paid stock photography, fonts, illustrations, and thousands of templates; a paid subscription that offers the ability to set up a brand kit so users can save their brand colours, fonts and assets, and ensure consistency across their designs; and a print service that gives our users the ability to produce professional prints in a variety of formats and sizes, delivered straight to their doorstep - Canva is disrupting the way we design.
